attachments_url_chk.name: attachments_url_chk
attachments_url_chk.value: url IS NULL OR (url ~ '^https?://' AND char_length(url) <= 2000)

files_size_chk.name: files_size_chk
files_size_chk.value: (width IS NULL OR width > 0) AND (height IS NULL OR height > 0)

meters_label_chk.name: meters_label_chk
meters_label_chk.value: label IS NULL OR char_length(label) BETWEEN 1 AND 80

places_unplaced_top_level_chk.name: places_unplaced_top_level_chk
places_unplaced_top_level_chk.value: NOT is_unplaced OR parent_id IS NULL

places_not_own_parent_chk.name: places_not_own_parent_chk
places_not_own_parent_chk.value: parent_id IS NULL OR parent_id <> id

purchases_money_chk.name: purchases_money_chk
purchases_money_chk.value: (total IS NULL AND tax IS NULL) OR currency IS NOT NULL

place_kinds_name_chk.name: place_kinds_name_chk
place_kinds_name_chk.value: name IS NULL OR char_length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 80

place_kinds_named_chk.name: place_kinds_named_chk
place_kinds_named_chk.value: owner_account_id IS NULL OR name IS NOT NULL

type_fields_label_chk.name: type_fields_label_chk
type_fields_label_chk.value: label IS NULL OR char_length(label) BETWEEN 1 AND 80

type_fields_unit_chk.name: type_fields_unit_chk
type_fields_unit_chk.value: unit IS NULL OR char_length(unit) BETWEEN 1 AND 12

types_named_chk.name: types_named_chk
types_named_chk.value: name IS NOT NULL OR builtin_key IS NOT NULL OR copied_from_id IS NOT NULL

types_name_chk.name: types_name_chk
types_name_chk.value: name IS NULL OR char_length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 80

types_default_meter_chk.name: types_default_meter_chk
types_default_meter_chk.value: default_meter IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(default_meter) IN ('object', 'null')

types_field_group_chk.name: types_field_group_chk
types_field_group_chk.value: NOT is_field_group OR (parent_id IS NULL AND cardinality(field_groups) = 0)

types_not_own_parent_chk.name: types_not_own_parent_chk
types_not_own_parent_chk.value: parent_id IS NULL OR parent_id <> id

secret_values_thing_current_uq.name: secret_values_thing_current_uq
secret_values_thing_current_uq.where: superseded_at IS NULL AND thing_id IS NOT NULL

secret_values_place_current_uq.name: secret_values_place_current_uq
secret_values_place_current_uq.where: superseded_at IS NULL AND place_id IS NOT NULL

locations_purge_needs_delete_chk.name: locations_purge_needs_delete_chk
locations_purge_needs_delete_chk.value: purge_after IS NULL OR deleted_at IS NOT NULL

short_ids_target_chk.name: short_ids_target_chk
short_ids_target_chk.value:
CASE state WHEN 'blank' THEN num_nonnulls(thing_id, place_id) = 0
                     WHEN 'assigned' THEN num_nonnulls(thing_id, place_id) = 1
                     ELSE num_nonnulls(thing_id, place_id) <= 1 END

things_not_own_container_chk.name: things_not_own_container_chk
things_not_own_container_chk.value: container_id IS NULL OR container_id <> id

things_named_chk.name: things_named_chk
things_named_chk.value: name IS NOT NULL OR review_state = 'draft'

things_name_chk.name: things_name_chk
things_name_chk.value: name IS NULL OR char_length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 200

things_in_use_chk.name: things_in_use_chk
things_in_use_chk.value: lifecycle <> 'in_use' OR (ended_on IS NULL AND ended_price IS NULL AND ended_to IS NULL)

saved_views_shared_chk.name: saved_views_shared_chk
saved_views_shared_chk.value: NOT shared OR location_id IS NOT NULL
